# Human Rights Watch
> Human Rights Watch investigates abuses, publishes evidence-based reporting, and advocates for justice in more than 100 countries.

Human Rights Watch is a global nonprofit organization focused on documenting human rights violations, producing reports, news releases, multimedia, and annual reviews, and organizing its work by region, country, and thematic issue. The site also provides extensive multilingual access to core content.

## Core Organization
- [Home](https://www.hrw.org): Main entry point for Human Rights Watch’s global research, news, campaigns, and regional coverage.
- [About Us](https://www.hrw.org/about/about-us): Overview of HRW’s mission, history, methods, and organizational approach.
- [Impact](https://www.hrw.org/impact): Examples of advocacy outcomes, policy influence, and campaign results.
- [Contact Us](https://www.hrw.org/contact-us): Contact information for media, offices, and general inquiries.
- [Careers](https://www.hrw.org/careers): Employment opportunities and information about working at Human Rights Watch.
- [Internships](https://www.hrw.org/internships): Internship opportunities and application information for students and early-career candidates.

## Publications & Media
- [Publications](https://www.hrw.org/publications): Searchable archive of reports, briefings, and major research publications.
- [World Report](https://www.hrw.org/world-report): Annual global review of human rights conditions by country and theme.
- [News](https://www.hrw.org/news): News releases, dispatches, statements, and advocacy updates.
- [Video & Photos](https://www.hrw.org/video-photos): Multimedia library of videos, photo essays, and visual reporting.
- [Podcasts](https://www.hrw.org/podcasts): Audio programs covering current human rights issues and investigations.

## Topics
- [Topics](https://www.hrw.org/topic): Directory of thematic human rights issues covered by HRW.
- [Women’s Rights](https://www.hrw.org/topic/womens-rights): Research and advocacy on gender equality, discrimination, and violence against women.
- [Children’s Rights](https://www.hrw.org/topic/childrens-rights): Coverage of child protection, education, labor, and justice issues.
- [LGBT Rights](https://www.hrw.org/topic/lgbt-rights): Reporting on discrimination, criminalization, and protections for LGBT people.
- [Refugees and Migrants](https://www.hrw.org/topic/refugees): Research on displacement, asylum, migration policy, and border abuses.
- [Disability Rights](https://www.hrw.org/topic/disability-rights): Documentation and advocacy related to accessibility, inclusion, and institutional abuse.
- [Freedom of Expression](https://www.hrw.org/topic/free-speech): Coverage of censorship, repression, media freedom, and dissent.
- [Arms](https://www.hrw.org/topic/arms): Research on weapons use, civilian harm, and arms control policy.

## Regions
- [Africa](https://www.hrw.org/africa): Regional hub for Human Rights Watch research and advocacy across Africa.
- [Asia](https://www.hrw.org/asia): Regional hub for country coverage and thematic work across Asia.
- [Europe/Central Asia](https://www.hrw.org/europe/central-asia): Regional coverage of Europe and Central Asia human rights developments.
- [Middle East/North Africa](https://www.hrw.org/middle-east/north-africa): Regional reporting on rights issues across the Middle East and North Africa.
- [United States](https://www.hrw.org/united-states): Coverage of domestic human rights issues in the United States.
- [Americas](https://www.hrw.org/americas): Regional hub for Latin America, the Caribbean, and broader Americas coverage.

## Africa Countries & Institutions
- [African Union](https://www.hrw.org/africa/african-union): Coverage of African Union institutions, policy, and regional human rights advocacy.
- [Angola](https://www.hrw.org/africa/angola): Country page for HRW reporting and updates on Angola.
- [Burkina Faso](https://www.hrw.org/africa/burkina-faso): Country page for research and news on Burkina Faso.
- [Burundi](https://www.hrw.org/africa/burundi): Country page for HRW reporting on Burundi.
- [Cameroon](https://www.hrw.org/africa/cameroon): Country page covering abuses, conflict, and accountability in Cameroon.
- [Central African Republic](https://www.hrw.org/africa/central-african-republic): Country page for investigations and advocacy on the Central African Republic.
- [Chad](https://www.hrw.org/africa/chad): Country page for HRW reporting on Chad.
- [Côte d'Ivoire](https://www.hrw.org/africa/cote-divoire): Country page for rights developments and reporting on Côte d'Ivoire.
- [Democratic Republic of Congo](https://www.hrw.org/africa/democratic-republic-congo): Country page for conflict, justice, and rights reporting on the DRC.

## Advocacy & Action
- [Take Action](https://www.hrw.org/take-action): Action center for petitions, campaigns, and public advocacy opportunities.
- [Donate Now](https://www.hrw.org/donate-now): Donation page supporting HRW’s research and advocacy work.
- [Events](https://www.hrw.org/events): Listings for public events, discussions, and organizational programs.
- [Defending Human Rights Worldwide](https://www.hrw.org/about): Broader organizational information and advocacy context.

## Languages
- [Languages](https://www.hrw.org/languages?language=en): Directory of Human Rights Watch language editions and translated content.
- [العربية](https://www.hrw.org/ar): Arabic-language homepage for HRW content and regional reporting.
- [简中](https://www.hrw.org/zh-hans): Simplified Chinese homepage for HRW content.
- [繁中](https://www.hrw.org/zh-hant): Traditional Chinese homepage for HRW content.
- [Français](https://www.hrw.org/fr): French-language homepage for HRW content and publications.
- [Deutsch](https://www.hrw.org/de): German-language homepage for HRW content.
- [日本語](https://www.hrw.org/ja): Japanese-language homepage for HRW content.
- [Português](https://www.hrw.org/pt): Portuguese-language homepage for HRW content.
- [Русский](https://www.hrw.org/ru): Russian-language homepage for HRW content.
- [Español](https://www.hrw.org/es): Spanish-language homepage for HRW content.
